title: The Blue Wave Has Tech Bros Scrambling for Data Centers in Space
gist: After Democrats, many opposed to data centers, swept the midterms including in Texas, tech figures led by Elon Musk pivoted to promoting space-based data centers, with Google, SpaceX, Blue Origin and Starcloud already pursuing orbital compute despite high costs and scale limits. In Texas, a split legislature, strong developer vested rights and weak county powers under Dillon's Rule limit how fast data center rules can change, though the governor and state agencies have near-term levers.
